calibration_sources: vLLM V1 Architecture Whitepaper (Isolated EngineCore, ZeroMQ IPC, Persistent InputBatch & CachedRequestData Delta)
SGLang Zero-Overhead Batch Scheduler (Overlap Scheduler with Future Token Map & Dual CUDA Streams)
Nsight Systems CPU-GPU Timeline Traces on 8xH100 / 8xH200 Running 70B FP8 Decode Steps

workload.hardware_and_model: 8xH200 / 8xB200 Node serving 70B FP8 (Batch Size = 128 concurrent decode requests; Pure GPU forward pass = 5.20 ms/step)
workload.cpu_bottleneck_physics: As GPUs get faster (5.2ms/step on H200/B200), a 5.8ms synchronous Python CPU scheduling + detokenization gap leaves the $300K GPU idle >52% of the time!
workload.overlap_mechanism: CPU prepares Step N+1 metadata & page tables while GPU executes Step N; Step N+1 uses a GPU-resident Future Token ID buffer without waiting for CPU cudaStreamSynchronize()

tiers.name: Tier 1: 单进程同步主循环 (vLLM V0 架构：HTTP/分词/调度/GPU 同抢 1 个 Python GIL = 暴露 5.80ms CPU 空泡 ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Monolithic Single-Process Loop (vLLM V0: HTTP + Tokenizer + Scheduler Share 1 GIL = 5.80ms Exposed CPU Bubble)
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy V0 prototypes only; GPU sits idle 52.7% of every decode step waiting for Python GIL, JSON parsing, and detokenization.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 多进程 ZMQ IPC 解耦 HTTP/Tokenizer + 每步全量重建张量元数据 (暴露 2.15ms CPU 空泡)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Multiprocess ZMQ IPC Frontend Split + Per-Step Full Metadata Rebuild (2.15ms Exposed CPU Bubble)
tiers.recommended_for: Intermediate multi-process engines; eliminates HTTP/Tokenizer GIL contention but still stalls GPU on synchronous sampler sync & full block-table copies.

tiers.name: Tier 3: vLLM V1 独立 EngineCore + 持久化增量批状态 (`CachedRequestData` 仅传增量 = 暴露 0.65ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: vLLM V1 Isolated EngineCore + Persistent Batch Delta State (`CachedRequestData` + `msgspec` = 0.65ms Exposed)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard vLLM V1 production deployments: caches request page tables across steps in GPU worker memory and transmits only 1-token deltas.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 零开销异步重叠调度器 (SGLang Overlap / vLLM V1 Async Output + GPU Future Token 槽位 = 仅 0.08ms 🏆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Zero-Overhead Overlap Scheduler (SGLang Overlap / vLLM V1 Async Output + GPU Future Token Slot = 0.08ms Exposed)
tiers.recommended_for: High-throughput H200/B200 serving & speculative decoding: hides 98.6% of CPU scheduling behind Step N GPU execution (108% higher throughput vs V0).
